What you will find at the counter

Four things Ghous Bakers & Sweets is known for — made fresh and ready through the day and late into the night.

Cakes

Celebration cakes and everyday bakes from the display counter — the centrepiece of the shop, ready for birthdays, family occasions and sweet cravings alike.

Biscuits

Crisp, golden biscuits in many shapes and styles — perfect with evening tea, for guests, or packed up to take home.

Sweets

Traditional mithai and sweets for celebrations, gifts and family gatherings — the classic taste Lahore loves.

Cold Drinks

Ice-cold drinks to go with your treats — a refreshing stop on Temple Road, from morning through to late night.
